newsitem.title: UK: Melrose Energy sees profits hit by budget.
newsitem.headline: Melrose Energy sees profits hit by budget.

text.p: Melrose Energy Plc said on Wednesday that tax changes proposed in Tuesday's UK budget will substantially hit profitability for the year to June 30, 1997.
The changes to the corporation tax regime for oil exploration firms will almost certainly preclude the launch of the Series V Partnership as planned for the spring of 1997.

"To put the possible impact in context, approximately 45 percent of the company's pro-forma pre-tax earnings of 15.3 million pounds for the year ended 30 June 30 1996 represented profit earned on the Melrose Series IV Partnership," it said.
The planned partnership is hit in particular by the government's plan to abolish the 100 percent deduction for intangible drilling costs.

"An important feature of the partnerships is the ability to pass through to limited partners the economic benefit of intangible drilling cost deductions," Melrose said, adding the tax changes will not materially affect existing partnerships.
Neither does the oil company see an impact on its own oil and gas developments.
"Accordingly, the directors remain confident in the company's existing business," Melrose said.
Melrose shares closed down 9-1/4 pence at 38-3/4.
